annotations.title: Net salary: Indonesia vs the Netherlands

description: Take-home pay of a job in Indonesia (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

combine_spouse.description: Spouse's income is combined with yours. Only when the wife has no separate NPWP; PTKP then adds 54 million. Default false.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many IDR, for the euro amounts. Default 17000 (indicative).

home_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in Indonesia, in IDR

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

nl_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in the Netherlands, in euros, without holiday allowance

nl_holiday_allowance.description: The Dutch job pays 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

nl_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The 30% ruling applies in the Netherlands. Default false.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in IDR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

name: compare_with_netherlands
title: Net salary: Indonesia vs the Netherlands
